data.title: LSD bust prompts warning to parents
data.description: Authorities have warned parents and schools to be vigilant after customs officers intercepted a shipment of LSD blotter paper printed with colourful cartoon designs that was allegedly destined for Thailand.

data.title: Welfare data to drive jobs push
data.description: The government plans to use data from its latest state welfare card registration to help more than five million working-age low-income people find jobs and improve their skills in a bid to address the root causes of poverty.

data.title: PM eyes redundant agencies
data.description: The government will begin dissolving a number of state agencies from September as part of a public sector reform programme aimed at eliminating overlapping responsibilities and improving administrative efficiency.

data.title: Thai courier arrested in Japan, 'ice' in client's package
data.description: A family is seeking help after their daughter was arrested in Japan on suspicion of drug smuggling after crystal methamphetamine was allegedly discovered hidden inside coffee sachets contained in a parcel she was paid to carry there.

data.title: Govt to begin abolishing redundant state agencies in Sept
data.description: The government will begin dissolving and merging state agencies with overlapping or obsolete functions from September, as part of a broader effort to streamline Thailand's public sector and improve competitiveness, Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt said on Sunday.

data.title: Tour van hits two vehicles on dangerous hill road
data.description: PHETCHABUN - A tour van had a brake malfunction, according to the driver, and hit two other vehicles, injuring six people, while descending Phu Thap Boek mountain in this northern province on Sunday.

data.title: Senate panel pushing Pha Taem, Sam Phan Bok onto global tourism map
data.description: UBON RATCHATHANI - A Senate committee has pledged support for improving transport links, tourism infrastructure and public information in Ubon Ratchathani, to raise the profile of Pha Taem National Park and strengthen Ubon Ratchathani Geopark's bid for Unesco Global Geopark status.

data.title: Raided hotel provided drugs, sex, gambling exclusively to Chinese
data.description: NONTHABURI - Police have raided a hotel in Muang district that was providing gambling, drugs and sex services for its exclusively Chinese guests.

data.title: Noisy Italian students case settled with apologies and fines
data.description: A dispute between a Thai woman and some noisy Italian students that sparked wide debate over public behaviour, cultural respect and online vigilantism has been formally resolved. The students apologised and paid fines imposed by police.

data.title: Drunk Myanmar driver kills 2 injures 2 in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - A drunk Myanmar driver hit several motorcycles, killed two people and injured two others on the road to a waterfall in Thalang district, police said on Sunday.

data.title: Thailand hosts important Asean judicial meetings
data.description: Thailand hosted important judicial meetings of Southeast Asian nations last week, during which senior Thai judges were elected to important positions within Asean judicial organisations.

data.title: Cops charged in Buaphan case
data.description: Seven Aranyaprathet police have been indicted for allegedly forcing a suspect to confess to the murder of Buaphan Tansu in 2024.

data.title: Over 100 tied to local exam fraud
data.description: A government committee estimates more than 100 people from the public and private sectors may be involved in the local government exam fraud process.

data.title: Abhisit says face iLaw investigation publicly
data.description: Politicians identified by iLaw in its Senate election collusion investigation should respond publicly first rather than resorting immediately to legal action, says Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva.

data.title: Frenchman shot by police dies
data.description: A French man succumbed to his wounds after being shot by police during a knife rampage that injured an officer in Suan Luang district.

data.title: Neighbours swap citizens
data.description: SA KAEO: Authorities on Friday repatriated 36 Thai nationals from Cambodia and returned 67 Cambodian nationals through the Klong Luek border checkpoint.

data.title: Japan lauds closer defence relations
data.description: Japan and Thailand have strengthened defence ties as security challenges intensify across the Indo-Pacific, with Tokyo describing Bangkok as an indispensable partner in maintaining regional peace.

data.title: B2.1bn in land seized in nominee bust
data.description: The Interior Ministry has seized 126 rai of land worth more than 2.1 billion baht in Krabi after uncovering an alleged foreign nominee scheme involving a British national.

data.title: Petrol station denied extra payout over Cambodian rocket hit
data.description: The Si Sa Ket petrol station hit by a Cambodian rocket last year will not receive further compensation as its losses were fully covered by insurance and its parent company, the government says.

data.title: 1,500 kids linked to fake birth registration network
data.description: Nearly 1,500 children are suspected of receiving fake birth registrations through a network linked to eight private hospitals to obtain fraudulent Thai citizenship, said deputy national police chief Pol Gen Samran Nualma.

data.title: Axing Land Bridge 'the right move'
data.description: Opposition parties have welcomed the government's decision to abandon the Land Bridge megaproject in favour of a scaled-down "Missing Link" transport strategy, saying the new approach is more economically viable and better aligned with existing infrastructure.

data.title: City to deploy eco inspectors
data.description: Bangkok will establish environmental inspectors to strengthen law enforcement, reduce pollution risks and improve public health across the city.

data.title: Govt planning to shrink state sector
data.description: The government plans to reduce the public workforce from three million to two million under civil service reforms.

data.title: Thailand celebrates ninth World Heritage site
data.description: Thailand celebrated a major cultural milestone on Saturday as the Unesco World Heritage Committee approved the inscription of Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan in Nakhon Si Thammarat as a World Cultural Heritage site.

data.title: Khlong Luang police chief transferred over alleged bribery
data.description: The chief of the Khlong Luang police station in Pathum Thani has been transferred to an inactive post pending an investigation after a recording purported to be of him soliciting bribes from the operator of a bar was circulated online.
